## v1.37.0

Adds catalog tagging, two converse options, a variables lookup, clearer errors on refused sessions and a guide to custom avatar looks that work with backgrounds. Three input checks are stricter and can break existing code, listed under Behavior change.

### Added

- `mgmt.application.getCustomVariables(agentId, ks)` lists the `{{ variables }}` an agent uses, system and custom. Use it to build a form for the values your app must send. Read only. (#435)
- `agentScope` on `catalog.createVoice`, `createVisual`, `createFace`, `createBackground` and `catalog.update`. It tags an item so you can filter lists by it. It is not access control. Pass `''` on update to clear it. (#440)
- Converse option `add_message_in_db`: `false` answers a turn without storing it, so a probe or a preview leaves no trace in the thread. (#441)
- Converse option `shared_message_id`: starts a new thread from that message. With `recoverFromSpiral`, the retry continues that new thread. An unknown id gives `empty_reply`. (#441)
- `err.serverCode` on a refused session holds the server's upper-case reason, such as `INVALID_KS`. Use it to tell an expired token from a bad one. `err.code` stays `unsupported_client`, so existing handlers keep working. (#438)
- `MODEL_IDS` adds `claude-sonnet-5` and `claude-haiku-4-5`. The JSDoc says which ids answered a live turn. (#442)

### Fixed

- The quickstart reads quoted `.env` values (`KEY="value"`). Before, a quoted secret was sent with its quotes and the first call failed. (#450)

### Behavior change

- A request variable whose name starts with lowercase `sys__` throws `validation_error` before any request. That prefix is reserved for system variables. The message names the key, never the value. Rename the variable. (#436)
- `skills.update` with `patch.name` applies the same character rule as `skills.add` (letters, digits, `_`, `-`). Any other name throws `bad_request`. (#436)
- A voice id for `importVoiceFromElevenLabs` or `importVoiceFromCartesia` must be 1 to 128 characters. Otherwise it throws `bad_request`. (#436)

### Docs and skill

- **Custom avatar look.** The docs now recommend a Face plus a Background for a custom avatar. A Face composes over a Background only when it is a transparent PNG cutout. An opaque photo keeps its own backdrop and ignores the Background, even a flat color. The design guide has the green-screen recipe and a keying script. A new live example swaps one Face over four image backgrounds and one flat color. `catalog.createFace` JSDoc says to upload a transparent PNG. No behavior change. (#451)
- `submitStructuredDataForm()` says the values go to the server and the agent does not see them. Use `speak()` or `updateRequestVars()` to give the agent the values. (#438)
- New size-limits section in `docs/api/operate.md`. (#438)
- `knowledge.removeSource` says a source that lists `categoryIds` is refused with `bad_request`. Delete the record to drop its categories. (#450)
- Avatar error titles, proven field limits for badges, insight settings and voice names, and a note that replies can differ at `temperature: 0`. (#443)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.36.5...v1.37.0
